release_rule: A substantive specialist training release requires independent expert approval of technical targets and translations; this pilot explicitly records pending review and makes no such release claim.
split_policy: Article/DOI and all language/task variants remain in one split across CPT, SFT and evaluation. Previously held-out v2 sources stay held out.
duplicate_policy: Reject exact duplicated paragraphs/examples and report cross-source 5-word-shingle Jaccard similarity >= 0.8 for human review. Intentional translations share a case family; they are not independent evidence.
evaluation_policy: Test sources, questions and rubrics must never enter training or hyperparameter selection. Compare base and adapter on identical prompts after freezing tuning on validation.
